DEVELOPMENT SUBSET - NOT FULL BENCHMARK: This manifest selects a fixed subset of upstream tasks for development iteration only. Any score computed from it must carry the label DEVELOPMENT SUBSET - NOT FULL BENCHMARK SCORE. It is not a Harness-Bench score and must never be compared with the full 106-task suite or with other benchmarks.
selection_rule: Fixed task-id selection committed with this manifest. Categories were enumerated from the upstream class field in tasks/<task_id>/task.yaml at the pinned commit. Selection is by id only, never by solved-status, difficulty outcome, or run results.

categories.selection_note: 15 of 22 upstream SE tasks, picked to cover debug, repair, tests, CI, migration, and review task shapes. The full SE class must be used for any reported SE score.
